policy: Raw microdata roots that no Chronicle registration witnesses yet (microcosm#848). One reviewed row per root, and the file is a ratchet: a row leaves when its root is pinned, but the row count may never exceed baseline_count. Adding an unpinned root therefore costs a pin somewhere else or a reviewed baseline change. A country absent from this file has every microdata root pinned.
